reasoning: This is a system status-bar indicator showing an empty cellular signal wedge with a padlock (zero-bar locked mobile network). As UI status chrome representing a device state rather than a concrete object, it reads poorly out of context—often looking like a geometric triangle or ramp with a lock—and fits only rare SIM/carrier-lock tasks.
